sourceFindings.summary: TABLET has geometry-backed overlap between navigatorChatHistory and navigatorPrompt.
TABLET has measurable clipped visible text: "ESSA Production Studio".
MOBILE has geometry-backed overlap between navigatorChatHistory and navigatorPrompt.
MOBILE has measurable clipped visible text: "Chat ESSA Navigator".

changedSelectorsOrComponents.previousBehavior: Compact prompt panel remained sticky at bottom on tablet/mobile Workspace mode.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.repair: Make compact prompt panel static within the flex column at the tablet/mobile breakpoint.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.reason: Prevents prompt geometry from overlaying navigatorChatHistory while keeping prompt visible and usable.

changedSelectorsOrComponents.previousBehavior: Horizontal navigation strip had no scroll padding for route-aligned active items.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.repair: Add scroll-padding-inline for predictable active item alignment.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.reason: Supports visible nav label alignment without hiding labels or changing nav structure.

changedSelectorsOrComponents.previousBehavior: Route activation toggled active class but did not align the active item inside the horizontal nav strip.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.repair: Scroll the active nav item into view with inline:start after active class update.
changedSelectorsOrComponents.reason: Prevents active or near-route labels from being partially visible after hash route load on tablet/mobile.

reason: Approved Phase 20S bounded repair for four Phase 20R findings: tablet/mobile chat-prompt overlap and tablet/mobile visible nav label clipping.
expectedOutcome: navigatorChatHistory and navigatorPrompt no longer overlap at 768x1024 or 390x844; active/visible nav labels are no longer clipped at tablet/mobile; desktop/laptop remain healthy.

rollbackPlan.method: Remove the Phase 20S CSS breakpoint additions and scrollActiveNavigationItem helper/call added in this repair attempt.
